description: This file defines the 'OneOf' class, which extends an abstract composite validator class and specifies a validation rule class from the 'Respect/Validation' library. It is part of a validation framework within the OrangeHRM system, particularly within the composite rules for API validation.

classes.name: OneOf
classes.description: A validation rule class that extends AbstractComposite and specifies a 'Respect/Validation' OneOf rule class.

methods.name: getRuleClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the validation rule ('Respect/Validation' OneOf class) used by this composite rule.
